{{Vanilla|Brewing Stand}}
{{Infobox auto}}
A '''kettle''' is the [[Matcha Flavoured]] name for the {{MCW|Brewing Stand|brewing stand}}. [[Brewing]] is effectively removed from the pack, so the kettle serves mainly as the job site block of the [[Chemist]] (the pack's cleric) and as decoration. Until {{Version|1.12.8-beta}} it was called the '''chemistry stand'''; the release notes list the new name as an expected issue: "Chemistry Stand name is messed up, don't worry about it (Shh)".<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.8-beta|quote=Chemistry Stand name is messed up, don't worry about it (Shh)}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The vanilla recipe, which needs a blaze rod, is replaced with one that uses an iron ingot and a [[Copper Ingot|copper ingot]] over three cobblestone, blackstone or cobbled deepslate.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/chemistry_stand.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref>

== Usage ==
=== Job site ===
The kettle is the job site block of the [[Chemist]], who sells [[Splash Potion|splash potions]].

=== Brewing ===
{{Main|Brewing}}
The kettle opens the vanilla brewing interface, which has no title since {{Version|1.12.8-beta}} (it was titled "Chemistry Stand" before),<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/lang/en_us.json}}</ref> but it cannot be fueled: the pack empties the <code>#minecraft:brewing_fuel</code> item tag, which normally holds blaze powder ([[Raw Estus]]).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/item/brewing_fuel.json}}</ref>
